Evidence text:
The principal anti-pattern is **claim compression**: many different competence levels collapse into identical icons.

For a career-analysis system, that creates several predictable failure modes:

1. a technology first added in 2026 may be incorrectly backdated to 2023 because the repo itself was created in 2023;
2. a technology used once may look equivalent to a repeatedly demonstrated skill;
3. a third-party framework icon may be mistaken for production experience;
4. a historical icon may remain after the skill becomes stale;
5. profile aesthetics can become stronger than evidence traceability.

Likely engineering lesson:

> **A portfolio claim becomes materially stronger when it is attached to an artifact, role, date, outcome and evidence class.**
